title: Sugar prices remain firm across India despite govt measures to check rise
summary: Sugar prices persist above sixty rupees per kilogram nationwide.  Government actions have not yet curbed the significant price increase.  Retail sugar costs have risen thirty percent in just one month.  Wholesale rates also show a substantial thirty-one percent month-on-month jump.  This situation persists even as ex-mill rates have declined.
